analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read is caused by `MDLImporter::ReplaceTextureWithColor()` iterating from `pcTexture->pcData + 1` up to `&pcTexture->pcData[iNumPixels]` without handling the single-pixel case. When `mWidth*mHeight == 1`, `pcTexel` starts at one-past-end and the loop condition `pcTexel != pcTexelEnd` is true, so it dereferences `*pcTexel` (and `*(pcTexel-1)`), reading beyond the allocation. The crash appears in `aiTexel::operator!=`, but the root cause is the incorrect iterator/end logic in `ReplaceTextureWithColor`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: PoV drives HMP->MDL7 skin parsing (`HMPImporter::ReadFirstSkin` -> `MDLImporter::ParseSkinLump_3DGS_MDL7`) to create an embedded texture via `ParseTextureColorData` with dimensions such that exactly one `aiTexel` is allocated (`mWidth*mHeight==1`). `ParseSkinLump_3DGS_MDL7` then unconditionally calls `ReplaceTextureWithColor(pcNew.get())`, which performs the invalid read for 1-pixel textures. Thus attacker-controlled model data must reach MDL7 skin texture parsing with nonzero width/height whose product is 1.
